Article title: Don’t filter your email based on AI detection

Article text:
Don’t filter your email based on AI detection
Keyvan’s blog
Subscribe Sign in Don’t filter your email based on AI detection
Pangram’s Gmail integration invites you to treat AI-assisted writing as spam
Share In August I wrote about why I think AI detectors in general are a bad idea : a positive detection tells you almost nothing about the human effort that went into the work being flagged. And yet, I wrote, AI detectors are being used “almost like spam filters”.
Well, less than a month after that post, Pangram, one of the leading AI detectors, released a Gmail integration. Let’s put aside, for now, the privacy implications of sending all your incoming email to a third-party…
